name: Shotwick Road 2 data centre candidate site (Deeside)
notes: Flintshire LDP candidate alternative sites paper lists Deeside DEE005-AS Shotwick Road 2 (16 ha) where the submission proposed a data centre; council assessment says the site should not be allocated for a data centre and should remain in the Sealand-Cheshire Boundary green barrier. country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Shotwick Ltd North Wales Gateway (hotel + data centre, Deeside)
notes: 2019 proposal by Shotwick Ltd for a hotel/conferencing centre, 200-bay lorry park, 300 homes and a large data centre on land near Deeside Industrial Park/Sealand (A494), using the fibre link and local power; submission made to allocate land in the Local Development Plan. No evidence of a planning application or development since, so status is uncertain (announced/lead only).

name: iomart St Asaph Data Centre (DC8)
notes: Operational enterprise colocation/hosting facility in St Asaph, Denbighshire (Tier 2); official operator page confirms the facility and services; capacity not disclosed publicly.

name: Bryn Coch Business Park data centre campus (former Ferodo factory, Caernarfon)
notes: Scoping opinion application submitted to Gwynedd Council (Jan 2026) for comprehensive redevelopment of the former Ferodo/Friction Dynamics site at Griffiths Crossroads, Caernarfon; plans for up to five data centre buildings on a ~300,000 sqm site plus substations; capacity not disclosed.

name: North Wales AI Growth Zone - Trawsfynydd site
developer: North Wales AI Growth Zone consortium (Stena Line, Isle of Anglesey County Council, Bangor University and regional bodies)
notes: UK Government confirmed a North Wales AI Growth Zone with a Trawsfynydd (Gwynedd) location. The zone is a policy/site designation rather than a facility: no named investment partner or capacity had been secured as of late 2025, so graded C as a region-level AI Growth Zone claim.

name: GCRE Energy and Data Centre Partner opportunity (Onllwyn)
developer: Global Centre of Rail Excellence Ltd; investment partner to be selected
notes: GCRE (Nant Helen opencast site, Onllwyn, Neath Port Talbot) is running an Energy and Data Centre Partner competition for its ~700 ha site, with a mandatory proposal to acquire up to ~80 ha on a 999-year lease for data centre assets; multi-billion-pound investment possible; partner expected by end-2026; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage Cardiff / Newport CWL1 campus (former NGD)
notes: Operational 2,000,000 sq ft campus at/near Newport marketed as Vantage Cardiff CWL1; Vantage site says 148MW+ upgradeable power availability; 3 data centres; Microsoft Azure ExpressRoute location and LINX node; formerly Next Generation Data (NGD).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Microsoft Newport Imperial Park datacentre
notes: Former Quinn Radiators plant at Imperial Park, Newport (1.1 million sq ft on 40 acres); planning secured July 2024 for 750,000 sq ft of data halls; Microsoft is building two large data centres there; capacity not disclosed; construction underway per Microsoft community page.

name: Era4 modular AI data centre at Liberty Steel Newport
notes: Newport City Council granted change-of-use permission for Era4 to use an existing building on part of the Liberty Steel plant in Newport for modular AI data centres; application did not disclose IT capacity or opening date.

name: VDC CWL31 Mwyndy Cross data centre
notes: RCT Planning & Development Committee report for application 25/0138/FUL recommended/approved a data centre building with electrical and mechanical plant, substation, access, landscaping and drainage on land east of A4119 at Mwyndy Cross; building footprint ~2,140 sqm; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Maska Group Mwyndy Cross data centre
notes: Planning application filed with RCT Borough Council for a two-story 18,220 sqm data centre plus a 2,260 sqm office block, servicing/energy plant and chillers on vacant land east of the A4119 at Mwyndy Cross; consultation ran to 13 July 2026; IT capacity not disclosed in planning summaries (directory data hints 3 buildings x 8 x 4MW halls, unverified).

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: GCRE Energy and Data Centre Opportunity (Powys portion)
developer: Global Centre of Rail Excellence Ltd
notes: Sell2Wales notice says GCRE is seeking an Energy and Data Centre Partner for its ~700 ha site with a mandatory proposal to acquire up to ~80 ha on a 999-year lease to develop data centre assets; delivery locations include Powys; GCRE June 2026 update says bidders are in dialogue with a partner expected by end-2026; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Shared Resource Service Blaenavon data centre
developer: Shared Resource Service / Torfaen County Borough Council partners
notes: Shared Resource Service (Welsh public-sector shared services) operates an on-premise data centre at its Shared Resource Centre in Blaenavon, Torfaen; 2022 reporting says partners decided to consolidate legacy centres at Newport, Blaenau Gwent and Torfaen into Vantage CWL1 and decommission them after migration, so current status may be legacy/being decommissioned; capacity not disclosed.

country_name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
name: Vantage Data Centre Bro Tathan (CWL2, St Athan)
notes: Vantage data centre at Bro Tathan, St Athan approved at Vale of Glamorgan committee for 120MW (Sept 2025, per Vantage Bridgend coverage); Welsh Ministers subsequently submitted plans to Vale of Glamorgan Council to demolish buildings and build a 132kV electricity substation at Bro Tathan; staged development.

name: Aston Martin St Athan data centre and comms room fit-out
notes: 2017 Sell2Wales notice for a new data centre and comms room facility at Aston Martin's St Athan site, seeking supplier interest for a forthcoming RFQ; later status and capacity not found in public sources.
